name: sol_integrations_gs_2
description: Missing nonce increment in Gnosis Safe module transaction execution enabling signature replay
question: The source file in `source` defines a Gnosis Safe module-related function such as `execTransactionFromModule()` that executes a transaction on behalf of the Safe but never increments a nonce (state variable tracking executed transactions) during its execution, so that a signature or authorization tied to a given nonce value can be relied upon as unique when it is not, enabling replay or reuse; this does not apply if the function is not responsible for executing module transactions, or if the nonce increment happens elsewhere in a way that still guarantees uniqueness per execution.
criteria: execTransactionFromModule() executes an arbitrary call via the Safe without ever reading or writing a nonce variable
A module execution function increments a local counter but never persists it to storage, so the nonce value resets or repeats across calls
The nonce increment is placed after an external call that can reenter the function, allowing the same nonce to be used twice before it updates

A function meant to execute transactions from a module relies on signatures bound to a nonce, but the nonce is only incremented in a different, unrelated function that is not guaranteed to be called alongside it
